courses.name: Coding with AI Agents and Skills
courses.audience: Developers and engineering leads curious about AI-assisted coding who want a first look before committing to a full workshop.
bullets: A 90-minute introduction to AI-assisted agentic coding: how it moved from one-off prompts, to agents, to reusable skills.
See what a skill is — scope, triggers, examples and expected output — and how it compares with raw prompting on the same task.
Learn where skills pay off most: code review standards, test generation, documentation and codebase onboarding.
Free to attend. If you want to go hands-on with your own repo afterwards, the Professional workshop is the next step.

courses.name: AI Agentic Coding & Skills for Developers — Professional
courses.duration: 7 hrs hands-on (1 day in person, or 3 virtual sessions) + 2 months virtual support
courses.audience: Working professionals with industry experience in software development and coding, but new to AI-assisted coding.
bullets: Built for working developers with real industry experience who want to master AI-assisted agentic coding.
Understand the evolution of AI coding and the current landscape — skills, agents, prompts, MCP, memory management, context, and other topics.
Learn how to use skills and agents well, then how to find and evaluate good ones before you adopt them. We also teach you how to build your own skills.
You walk away with a 50-skill plugin pack, ready to build your next application. We will support you until you master what we taught you.
checklist: A laptop with your normal development environment set up
A repo of your own to work on

courses.name: AI Agentic Coding & Skills for Developers — Advanced
courses.duration: 1 day · 7 hrs in person + 2 months virtual support
courses.audience: Working professionals who've completed our Professional course, or already have an equivalent understanding.
bullets: Built for developers who've completed our Professional course, or already work at that level.
Learn advanced techniques for writing skills, hosting your own MCP server, working with frameworks, optimizing LLM cost, hosting your own LLM, and building context.

You walk away with the Professional and Advanced skill plugin pack, ready to build your next application or become a superstar developer in your org. We will support you until you master what we taught you.
checklist: A laptop with your normal development environment set up
A repo of your own to work on

courses.name: Governed Agentic SDLC
courses.audience: Engineering leads and organizations ready to roll out agentic coding — and govern it — across their whole team.
bullets: Everything in our developer-facing skills training, brought to your whole engineering org.
Governance of skills and agents — who's allowed to build, publish, and run them, and against which systems.
Security and compliance guardrails built for agentic development from the start, not bolted on after.
Enforcement of standards and templates, so every team's skills meet the same bar before they ship.
Cost monitoring and optimization — track and control LLM spend across your organization.
A curriculum scoped to your org's stack, maturity level, and goals — talk to us and we'll build it with you.
